definition.en: Maritime communities of the Malay world living along coasts and on boats; some served Malay rulers as navigators, rowers and patrol forces.
definition.zh: 【待译】Maritime communities of the Malay world living along coasts and on boats; some served Malay rulers as navigators, rowers and patrol forces.

definition.en: A senior office in the Johor Sultanate concerned with security and maritime communities. Abdul Rahman held the office in Singapore in 1819.
definition.zh: 【待译】A senior office in the Johor Sultanate concerned with security and maritime communities. Abdul Rahman held the office in Singapore in 1819.

definition.en: A port without ordinary import or export duties. Colonial Singapore raised revenue through other means, including monopolies.
definition.zh: 【待译】A port without ordinary import or export duties. Colonial Singapore raised revenue through other means, including monopolies.

definition.en: A concession auctioned by a government, allowing a merchant to collect income from a specified monopoly or tax. In Singapore these included opium, alcohol and gambling.
definition.zh: 【待译】A concession auctioned by a government, allowing a merchant to collect income from a specified monopoly or tax. In Singapore these included opium, alcohol and gambling.

definition.en: The British administrative grouping formed in 1826 from Penang, Malacca and Singapore; later additions included Dindings and Labuan. It ended in 1946.
definition.zh: 【待译】The British administrative grouping formed in 1826 from Penang, Malacca and Singapore; later additions included Dindings and Labuan. It ended in 1946.

definition.en: A colony administered directly by the British government rather than by the East India Company or British India. The Straits Settlements acquired this status in 1867.
definition.zh: 【待译】A colony administered directly by the British government rather than by the East India Company or British India. The Straits Settlements acquired this status in 1867.

definition.en: Malay for a village or settlement. Colonial town plans also used the word for areas assigned to particular communities.
definition.zh: 【待译】Malay for a village or settlement. Colonial town plans also used the word for areas assigned to particular communities.

definition.en: A historical and now derogatory term for Asian manual workers, often recruited through labour agents. This topic uses the term only with historical explanation.
definition.zh: 【待译】A historical and now derogatory term for Asian manual workers, often recruited through labour agents. This topic uses the term only with historical explanation.

definition.en: An arrangement in which an agent advanced a migrant’s travel costs and expected repayment through work after arrival. Debt could restrict the worker’s choices.
definition.zh: 【待译】An arrangement in which an agent advanced a migrant’s travel costs and expected repayment through work after arrival. Debt could restrict the worker’s choices.

definition.en: A system in which an Indian foreman recruited workers through connections in India for employment, notably on plantations.
definition.zh: 【待译】A system in which an Indian foreman recruited workers through connections in India for employment, notably on plantations.

definition.en: A Chinese association that might organise mutual help, business or secret-society loyalties. Clan associations and secret societies were not identical organisations.
definition.zh: 【待译】A Chinese association that might organise mutual help, business or secret-society loyalties. Clan associations and secret societies were not identical organisations.

definition.en: Locally born communities whose family histories and cultures developed in the Malay world, often combining inherited and local languages and practices. The term is not limited to Chinese descendants.
definition.zh: 【待译】Locally born communities whose family histories and cultures developed in the Malay world, often combining inherited and local languages and practices. The term is not limited to Chinese descendants.

definition.en: An official appointed beside a Malay ruler whose advice was generally to be followed in administration, with exceptions for Malay religion and custom.
definition.zh: 【待译】An official appointed beside a Malay ruler whose advice was generally to be followed in administration, with exceptions for Malay religion and custom.

definition.en: Responsibility for domestic government exercised by Singapore’s elected ministry from 1959, while Britain retained responsibilities including defence and external relations.
definition.zh: 【待译】Responsibility for domestic government exercised by Singapore’s elected ministry from 1959, while Britain retained responsibilities including defence and external relations.

definition.en: Singapore’s entry into Malaysia in 1963 with Malaya, Sabah and Sarawak. The terms were politically disputed.
definition.zh: 【待译】Singapore’s entry into Malaysia in 1963 with Malaya, Sabah and Sarawak. The terms were politically disputed.

definition.en: Indonesia’s political and military campaign against the formation of Malaysia, beginning in 1963 and ending in 1966.
definition.zh: 【待译】Indonesia’s political and military campaign against the formation of Malaysia, beginning in 1963 and ending in 1966.
